Container.Name: inkjet-conditioner
Container.Overview: Host-networked inkjet maintenance prints to help prevent nozzle clogs on Unraid.
Container.Description:
Inkjet Conditioner is a lightweight local printing utility built for Unraid. It automatically discovers LAN printers through Bonjour/mDNS and common print services, then schedules regular low-volume maintenance prints to help prevent inkjet nozzle clogs.
Host networking is required for reliable automatic printer detection because Bonjour/mDNS multicast and the fallback LAN scan need access to Unraid's LAN interface. Bridge, macvlan, ipvlan, and isolated networks may still print to manually configured printer IPs, but discovery is not guaranteed.
The app stores its config in persistent appdata and exposes a small web UI so you can confirm printer settings, test the print path, and adjust the schedule without editing container environment variables by hand.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port used by the built-in web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI Username
Config.Description: Username required to access the Web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI Password
Config.Description: Password required to access the Web UI. Change this before exposing the app outside your trusted network.

Config.Name: Appdata Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for app settings, printer discovery, and print jobs.

Config.Name: Shared Print Folder
Config.Description: Folder containing documents or uploaded files that should be printed.

Config.Name: Printer Name
Config.Description: Friendly printer name shown in the UI and logs.

Config.Name: Printer Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of the printer on the local network.

Config.Name: Printer URI
Config.Description: Optional printer URI such as ipp://192.168.1.50/ipp/print.

Config.Name: Maintenance Print Text
Config.Description: Text included in the maintenance print when no document is selected.

Config.Name: Document Path
Config.Description: Optional document to print each time the scheduler or test action runs.

Config.Name: Uploaded Document Name
Config.Description: Friendly name used when a document is uploaded to the app data directory.

Config.Name: Schedule Type
Config.Description: Choose daily, weekly, or monthly scheduling.

Config.Name: Schedule Hour
Config.Description: Hour of the day when the job should run.

Config.Name: Schedule Day of Month
Config.Description: Day of month used for monthly schedules.

Config.Name: Schedule Description
Config.Description: Human-readable description shown in logs and the status page.
